skos:definition: Whether mathematical corrections for isobaric, polyatomic or residual interferences are applied in data reduction, supplementary to any suppression already achieved by chemical separation, mass resolution, or a collision/reaction cell. Detail for each affected mass is carried by Interfering Species

skos:hasTopConcept.skos:prefLabel: No explicit corrections applied; medium resolution resolves the polyatomic interferences
skos:hasTopConcept.skos:notation: No explicit corrections applied; medium resolution resolves the polyatomic interferences

skos:hasTopConcept.skos:prefLabel: Yes — doubly-charged Er and Yb on the Sr and Rb masses
